The '''A-7 Hunter Interceptor''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] class made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
The A-7 Hunter had no [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], minimal amount of support systems and only two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. It was similar in most respects to the TIE starfighters, but was more agile, and relatively more expensive.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
The A-7 was an update of a line of Kuat fighters, with which they hoped to supply the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in addition to [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The initial impression was good, with many officers buying dozens of fighters for use onboard their vessels.<ref name="TFUCG" />

When the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] series was selected instead, the A-7 declined in popularity and disappeared from most Imperial units, though some in fringe systems kept them as part of their forces. The fighter was also used by mercenaries and insurgent groups.
Although the craft was fast, agile and cheap, it was still more expensive to construct than a TIE,<ref name="TFUCG" /> which led to it being passed over by the Empire.<ref name="DC">''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The A-7 Hunter is first mentioned in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''.
